title: 第3章 世道艰难第4章 都是妖
lines: 第3章世道艰难
盛夏看着头顶上那一团亮极的白光，一团黑影对着白光疾冲而出，盛夏直直的看着黑影，一股痛到心脏瞬间裂开般的痛楚中夹杂着极端的恐惧猛冲上来，盛夏一声惨叫，呼的坐直，从梦中惊醒。
“怎么了？”米丽听到惨叫，立刻冲进来。
“别开灯，我没事，做了个梦。”盛夏浑身冷汗，微微颤抖，梦中那股惨痛和恐惧还残留在身体里，她不想看到象那团白光一样的灯光。
“喝口水。”米丽倒了杯温水，递给盛夏，“是前几年做过的那个梦？你之前没吓成这样。”
盛夏接过杯子，双手捧着，举在唇边，却没喝，闭着眼睛，等那股子惨痛褪去，不再颤栗了，才轻轻舒了口气，将杯子递给米丽。
“是，这次梦到的多了一点儿，有个黑影冲向那团白光，那个黑影……”盛夏的话顿住，有几分怔忡。
之前的梦，她看着那团亮极的白光，没有痛楚，也没有恐惧，除了好奇，几乎没有别的感觉，这一次，是因为那个扑向白光的黑影，她看着那个黑影，才恐惧，才痛的整个人都要碎了。
想着那份恐惧和痛楚，盛夏微微颤栗了下，那份痛楚，让她甚至不愿再回想那个梦。
什么事，能让一个人痛苦惊惧成那样？
“再睡一会儿吧，离天亮还早。”米丽看着盛夏怔忡中透着痛苦恐惧的神情，没敢再多问。
“睡不着了，你给我沏壶老白茶，我到门口坐一会儿。”盛夏下了床。
“嗯。”米丽跟着站起来，将床尾凳上一条米白披肩递给盛夏。
盛夏接过披上，走到廊下，盘膝坐在那张阔大软沙发上，看着院子中清冷的月色。怔怔的想着刚才的梦，想着那份痛到极处。
好一会儿，盛夏举起手，看着手腕上新添的那三只青铜疙瘩。
她得到玛瑙珠子时，开始做梦，现在这三只青铜疙瘩，带来了一个黑影，和一份撕心裂肺的痛楚惊惧。
盛夏将那只玛瑙珠子和三只青铜疙瘩握在手心里，看着院子一角果实累累的石榴树，脑子里一片空空的出了神。
米丽端着茶盘出来，轻轻放到盛夏手边矮几上，拿起壶，倒了半杯茶，茶水落在杯子里的哗啦声，惊醒了盛夏，盛夏恍过神，接过茶，垂着眼皮抿了几口，低低道：“老米，咱们得有钱。”
她上次想去那场高端拍卖会，就是因为拍品中有一粒翡翠珠子，让她有一丝熟悉的感觉，她想靠近看看，最好摸一下，可惜没能混进去。
她得有钱到能进那样的拍卖会。
“钱还有点儿，要多少？仓库里东西多得很，那些东西越来越值钱了，拿几件出来卖了？”米丽看着盛夏，有点儿摸不准她说的有钱，是多有钱。
“咱们那点儿钱太少了，仓库里的东西拿出来容易，过到明路麻烦，现在的世道，什么东西都得有个来路。”盛夏语调里都是烦恼。
“可不是！这世道，越来越艰难，从那什么照像机出来，我就知道那不是好东西，果然吧，看看现在，什么血型指纹，这个光那个光，以前装个病，不过诊个脉，想怎么糊弄就怎么糊弄，现在好了，一滴血，是人是妖全出来了，真是！还有这身份，从前咱们想换个身份，多简单，你说什么就是什么，隔个百八十里，就没得查了，现在，从球那头跑到球这头，想查照样你分分钟一清二楚！唉，这世道真是越来越艰难，真不是人过的日子。”
盛夏几句话，勾起了米丽无数烦恼和牢骚。
盛夏听的笑起来，“老米，这是人过的好日子，可你不是人哪。”
“唉！可不是！”米丽拍着大腿一声长叹，“我看哪，以后肯定越来越艰难。”
“算不上越来越艰难，从前咱们也难，难处不一样而已，现在的日子，至少比从前舒服多了。不说这个了，咱们得把这样的东西都找回来。得有很多钱，明天你去一趟宋家，把这条线搭起来吧，接些案子赚点钱。还有，给周凯留个信息，告诉他咱们现在在滨海，以后就长住这儿了。”
盛夏安排道。
米丽听到最后，眉开眼笑，“一会儿我先给周凯留个信儿，明天早上买菜回来，路过宋家，他家就该开门儿了。他们家那小侦探铺儿不象样儿归不象样儿，门开的挺早，他们宋家人都是一个德行，笨归笨，勤快是真勤快。”
盛夏习惯早起，不过这一觉被噩梦搅了，和米丽说着话坐到天明时，困倦却上来了，米丽拎着篮子出门买菜，盛夏干脆回屋去睡回笼觉。
盛夏打着呵欠闭上眼睛睡回笼觉时，环贸大厦顶层，装修奢侈的客厅里，那位头一面让保安把盛夏拖出几百米远，第二面被盛夏拒卖青铜疙瘩的冷峻男子，正低头看着手里的两份报告。
两份报告都是关于盛夏的，一份人道，一份妖道，人妖两道都简单平常。
和他有过两面不善缘的小姑娘叫盛夏，地地道道一个人，今年二十，说是刚生下来一两个月，父母就没了，她是跟着小姨米丽长大的。
狐妖米丽装成人的那一面，经历十分复杂，先是嫁了个索马里人，后来带着盛夏偷渡到欧洲，再嫁了个意大利人，没几年就离了婚，跟了个有钱的加拿大籍华人，从加拿大再到美国，又从美国跑到澳州。
一年前，米丽来到临港，拿出份产业证明，和一份转让声明，把那座闹中取静、价值不菲的小院转到自己名下，住了进去。
如今米丽和盛夏在离家几步外的古玩街上开了家旧货铺子，靠倒腾些真假不知的不值钱物件挣点小钱，两个人是各个三流，以及不入流拍场，和各大黑市的常客。
还是每天上午十点更新，这一本争取定时更新不断更到结文！
（本章完）

Chapter 3 The world is tough
Shengxia looked at the bright white light above her head, and a black shadow rushed out against the white light. Shengxia looked straight at the black shadow, and a pain that was so painful that her heart burst instantly mixed with extreme fear rushed up. Shengxia screamed, sat upright, and woke up from her dream.
"What's wrong?" Milly heard the scream and rushed in immediately.
"Don't turn on the light. I'm fine. I had a dream." Shengxia was covered in cold sweat and trembling slightly. The pain and fear in the dream still remained in her body. She didn't want to see a light like that white light.
"Drink some water." Milly poured a glass of warm water and handed it to Shengxia, "Is it the dream you had a few years ago? You have never been so scared before."
Shengxia took the cup, held it with both hands, and raised it to her lips, but did not drink. She closed her eyes. When the pain subsided and she stopped trembling, she breathed a sigh of relief and handed the cup to Millie.
"Yes, I dreamed a little more this time. There was a black shadow rushing towards the white light. That black shadow..." Shengxia paused, feeling a little startled.
In the previous dream, when she looked at the bright white light, she felt no pain or fear. She felt almost no other feeling except curiosity. This time, it was because of the black figure that jumped towards the white light. When she looked at the black figure, she felt fear and pain that made her whole body break.
Thinking of the fear and pain, Shengxia shuddered slightly. The pain made her not even want to think about that dream again.
What could make a person so painful and frightened like that?
"Let's sleep a little longer, it's still early before dawn." Millie looked at Sheng Xia's stunned expression with pain and fear, and didn't dare to ask any more questions.
"I can't sleep anymore. Make me a pot of old white tea. I'll sit at the door for a while." Shengxia got out of bed.
"Yes." Milly stood up and handed an off-white shawl on the end of the bed stool to Shengxia.
Shengxia took the shawl, walked to the corridor, sat cross-legged on the large soft sofa, and looked at the cold moonlight in the yard. I was thinking about the dream just now and how painful it was.
After a while, Shengxia raised her hand and looked at the three new bronze bumps on her wrist.
When she got the agate beads, she started to dream. Now these three bronze lumps brought a black shadow and a heart-breaking pain and fear.
Shengxia held the agate bead and the three bronze beads in her hand, looking at the fruit-laden pomegranate tree in the corner of the yard, her mind was empty and lost in thought.
Mili came out with the tea tray, put it gently on the low table next to Sheng Xia, picked up the pot, and poured half a cup of tea. The sound of tea falling into the cup woke up Sheng Xia. Sheng Xia regained consciousness, took the tea, took a few sips with lowered eyelids, and said in a low voice: "Old Mi, we must be rich."
The last time she wanted to go to that high-end auction, it was because there was an jade bead in the auction that gave her a slightly familiar feeling. She wanted to take a closer look, preferably touch it, but unfortunately she couldn't get in.
She had to be rich enough to enter an auction like that.
"I still have some money, how much do I need? There are a lot of things in the warehouse, and those things are getting more and more valuable. How many of them are you selling?" Millie looked at Sheng Xia, a little unsure of how rich she meant.
"The money we have is too little. It's easy to take things out of the warehouse, but it's troublesome to find a way out. In today's world, everything must have a way to come from." Shengxia's tone was full of worry.
"No! This world is getting more and more difficult. I knew it was not a good thing when those cameras came out. Sure enough, look at the blood type fingerprints now, this light and that light. I used to pretend to be sick, just check the pulse, and fool myself as much as I want. Now it's fine. A drop of blood can tell whether it is a human or a demon. Come on, it’s true! And this identity, in the past we wanted to change our identity, it was so easy, we just said it, and there was no need to check it one hundred and eighty miles away. Now, if you want to run from the other side of the ball, you can still check it every minute! Alas, this world is getting more and more difficult, it is really not a human life. "
A few words from Sheng Xia evoked countless worries and complaints from Millie.
Shengxia laughed when she heard this, "Old Mi, this is a good life for human beings, but you are not human."
"Alas! No!" Milly slapped her thigh and sighed, "I see, it will definitely become more and more difficult in the future."
"It's not getting harder and harder. It was difficult for us in the past, but the difficulties are different. Today's life is at least much more comfortable than before. Let's not talk about it. We have to find all these things. We have to have a lot of money. Tomorrow you go to the Song family to set up this line and take some cases to make some money. Also, leave a message to Zhou Kai and tell him that we are in Binhai now and will live here forever."
Sheng Xia arranged.
Milly smiled happily when she heard the last part, "I'll leave a message to Zhou Kai later. When I come back from shopping for groceries tomorrow morning, I'll pass by Song's house. His house should be open. Their little detective shop is not decent at all. It opens very early. The Song family are all virtuous. They are stupid but they are stupid. They are really diligent."
Shengxia was used to getting up early, but this time her sleep was disturbed by nightmares. She sat talking to Mi Li until dawn, but then she felt sleepy. Mi Li carried a basket and went out to buy groceries, so Shengxia simply went back to the house and took a nap.
……………………
When Sheng Xia yawned and closed her eyes to fall asleep, in the luxuriously decorated living room on the top floor of the International Trade Building, the stern man who first asked the security guards to drag Sheng Xia a few hundred meters away, and then was refused by Sheng Xia to sell him a bronze pimple, was looking down at the two reports in his hand.
Both reports are about Midsummer, one is humane and the other is demonic, both human and demonic are simple and ordinary.
The little girl who had a bad relationship with him was called Shengxia. She was a real person. She was twenty this year. It was said that her parents died just a month or two after she was born. She grew up with her aunt Mi Li.
The fox demon Milli's side of pretending to be an adult has a very complicated experience. First she married a Somali, then smuggled to Europe with Sheng Xia, then married an Italian, divorced within a few years, and followed a wealthy Chinese Canadian, traveling from Canada to the United States, and then from the United States to Australia.
A year ago, Millie came to Lingang, took out a property certificate and a transfer statement, transferred the valuable and quiet courtyard to her own name, and lived in it.
Now Mili and Shengxia have opened a second-hand shop on the antique street a few steps away from their home, making a little money by selling worthless items whose authenticity is unknown. The two of them are regular customers of various third-rate and low-rate auction houses, and major black markets.
It will still be updated at ten o'clock every morning. This book will be updated regularly until the end!
(End of chapter)
